summary: Integration: test/smoke.sh now 13/13 and SAFE to run alongside the live daemon — PID-based daemon control (no pkill), isolated CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA, port-specific stale-clear. Covers core graph+derivation, review gate, multi-workspace read (?workspace=), SSE push-on-mutation, loop persistence across restart, format-drift health. Bearer-token auth verified separately (401/200 matrix). Fixed two harness footguns surfaced during dogfooding: pkill killing the live :8787 daemon, and shared BASE clobbering the persisted workspace.
